_comment: marble_wall_arc: a placeable ashlar wall curved with the lane -- faces concentric with the ring at VARIANTS[radius], arc_deg wide, height tall, thickness thick; a proud plain-ashlar socle and end piers, whole brick courses between, a fluted cap. Origin the base centre on the mid bearing at radius, +X radial out, +Z toward increasing bearing. MarbleWallArcCollision: one -colonly arc prism over the piers' footprint. Variants: '' (r 47.3, 11.4 deg, 7.6 m), long (19.7 deg), low (3.0 m: Section B's). The brick is the same size on every variant: U by arc length, V by world height, never scaled to the wall.
